text.body: sukalyāṇīṃ vāṇīṃ suramunivaraiḥ pūjitapadām | śivām ādyāṃ vandyām tribhuvanamayīṃ vedajananīṃ | parāṃ śaktiṃ sraṣṭuṃ vividha vidha rūpāṃ guṇa mayīṃ | bhaje ambāṃ gāyatrīṃ parama subhagā naṃdajananīma || viśuddhāṃ sattvasthāma akhila duravasthādiharaṇīm | nirākārāṃ sārāṃ suvimala tapo murtiṃ atulāṃ | jagat jyeṣṭhāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sura asura pūjyāṃ śrutinutāṃ | bhaje ambāṃ gāyatrīṃ parama subhagā naṃdajananīm | tapo niṣṭhāṃ abhiṣṭāṃ svajanamana saṃtāpa śamanīma dayāmūrtiṃ sphūrtiṃ yatitati prasādaika sulabhāṃ vareṇyāṃ puṇyāṃ tāṃ nikhila bhavabandhāpa haraṇīṃ bhaje ambāṃ gāyatrīṃ parama subhagā naṃdajananīma sadā ārādhyāṃ sādhyāṃ sumati mati vistārakaraṇīṃ viśokāṃ ālokāṃ hradayagata mohāndhaharaṇīṃ parāṃ divyāṃ bhavyāṃ agama bhava sindhveka taraṇīṃ bhaje ambāṃ gāyatrīṃ parama subhagā naṃdajananīma ajāṃ dvaitāṃ tretāṃ vividha guṇarūpāṃ suvimalāṃ tamo hantrīṃ tantrīṃ śruti madhuranādāṃ rasamayīṃ mahāmānyāṃ dhanyāṃ satatakarūṇāśīla vibhavāṃ bhaje ambāṃ gāyatrīṃ parama subhagā naṃdajananīma jagat dhātrīṃ pātrīṃ sakala bhava saṃhārakaraṇīṃ suvīrāṃ dhīrāṃ tāṃ suvimalatapo rāśi saraṇīṃ anaikāṃ aikāṃ vai trayajagat adhiṣṭhān padavīṃ bhaje ambāṃ gāyatrīṃ parama subhagā naṃdajananīma prabuddhāṃ buddhāṃ tāṃ svajanayati jāḍyāpaharaṇīṃ hiraṇyāṃ guṇyāṃ tāṃ sukavijana gītāṃ sunipuṇīṃ suvidyāṃ niravadyāmamala guṇagāthāṃ bhagavatīṃ bhaje ambāṃ gāyatrīṃ parama subhagā naṃdajananīma anantāṃ śāntāṃ yāṃ bhajati vudha vṛndaḥ śrutimayīma sugeyāṃ dhyeyāṃ yāṃ smarati hradi nityaṃ surapatiḥ sadā bhaktyā śaktyā praṇatamatibhiḥ pritivaśagāṃ bhaje ambāṃ gāyatrīṃ parama subhagā naṃdajananīma śuddha citaḥ paṭhedyastu gāyatryā aṣṭakaṃ śubham aho bhāgyo bhavelloke tasmin mātā prasīdati
